name: ppt-master
tagline_zh: 正经办公文档：ppt-master。英文简介见下。
desc_en: AI-driven presentation workflow for generating editable PPTX decks, creating reusable Brand/Style/Layout/Deck workspaces, filling native PPTX templates, and enhancing finished PPTX files. Use when the user asks to create, regenerate, template, fill, or enhance a presentation, or mentions ppt-master.
